outline:

(8)	正齒輪及螺旋齒輪

(10) 傳動軸與輪軸
(1)	Design Introduction, Problem Solving
(2)	Load and stress analysis
(3)	Static load damage, fatigue failure due  to dynamic load.
(4)	Design of screw, fasteners and non-permanent joints
(5)	Welding, bonding, and permanent joints design
(6)	Mechanical spring
(7)	Rolling contact bearings
(8)	Spur gears and helical gears
(9)	Clutches, Brakes, Couplings, and Flywheels

schedule:
Part 1 Fundamentals
Chapter 1 Mechanical Engineering Design in Broad Perspective (1 week)
Chapter 2 Load Analysis
Chapter 3 Materials
Chapter 4 Static Body Stresses
Chapter 5 Elastic strain, Deflection, and Stability (1 week)
Chapter 6 Failure Theories, Safety Factors, and Reliability (1 week)
Chapter 7 Impact
Chapter 8 Fatigue (2 weeks)
Chapter 9 Surface Damage

Part 2 Applications
Chapter 10 Threaded Fasteners and Power Screws  (2 weeks)
Chapter 11 Rivets, Welding, and Bonding (1 week)
Chapter 12 Springs  (2 weeks)
Chapter 13 Lubrication and Sliding Bearings  (2 weeks)
Chapter 14 Rolling-Element Bearings (1 week)
Chapter 15 Spur Gears  (2 weeks)
Chapter 16 Helical, Bevel, and Worm Gears
Chapter 17 Shafts and Associated Parts  (2 weeks)
Chapter 18 Clutches and Brakes (1 week)
